item.text: The existing code has the right broad insertion point, but its HTML detector is too permissive: it treats malformed tags and email-like text as block HTML, and its inline tag regex accepts invalid attributes. I’m tightening both detectors around the CommonMark tag grammar and preserving the original source text for valid constructs.
